content:
Rafael G.: quick Q — traveling next wk to demo a prototype. it's bulky so i'll check an extra bag for the equipment. can i expense the extra baggage fee and the bulky-item surcharge? approx $240 roundtrip.
Maya (People Ops): short answer: usually yes if the equipment is business-owned or preapproved, or if it's personal but required for a customer demo and preapproved. :package:
Rafael G.: it's company prototype kit (asset tag pending). i couldn't get Travel Desk to fit it in the carry-on. booked a separate checked bag on my personal card to avoid missing the flight.
Ivy (Travel Desk): note: when possible, Travel Desk should book excess baggage on the corporate card. for last-minute personal bookings we can still retroactively move charges if you submit the ticket and manager approval.
Rafael G.: how do i get preapproval retroactively?
Maya (People Ops): send people-ops@redwood.com with subject "Equipment baggage reimbursement - [Name] [dates]" and cc your manager. include: 1) proof of travel/itinerary, 2) the baggage receipt showing fee and bag description, 3) a short note confirming the item is company property or business-critical, and 4) manager approval screenshot or email. We'll review within 3 business days.
Jordan (manager): @Rafael G. this demo is customer-critical. I approve the baggage fees—please include me on the email so People Ops has the manager sign-off.
Rafael G.: thanks. any special notes about packing declared lithium batteries or foam crating?
Maya (People Ops): safety rules: if the kit contains lithium batteries, you must follow airline hazardous materials rules — batteries >100Wh need airline approval and sometimes require carry-on. if you bought checked transport against rules, airline may deny or fine; those fines are not reimbursable. include photos of packing and the airline's declaration (if any).
Ivy (Travel Desk): also, airlines sometimes charge an "oversize/overweight" fee and a separate "special item" fee (e.g., for equipment). include both receipts. if the carrier offers an equipment manifest or pro forma invoice at check-in, add that to your docs.
Rafael G.: what about shipping instead? i could ship the crate via courier; is that reimbursable and any preference?
Maya (People Ops): shipping or checked baggage both ok. preferred: Travel Desk arranges corporate shipment or courier using the corporate account (cheaper and insured). If you ship on your personal account, include the tracking, invoice, and manager approval. For declared high-value items (> $2,500), we require preapproval and a formal asset transfer record.
FinanceBot: finance note: for shipped items, finance needs the commercial invoice, carrier receipt, tracking, and proof of payment. For international trips, include customs paperwork and any duties/taxes paid. Reimbursement currency and conversion must be shown.
Rafael G.: do i need to mark the kit as company asset first?
Maya (People Ops): if it's company property, tag it when you return. for high-value prototypes we prefer an equipment loan form before travel. since this is short-notice, include a post-travel asset registration ticket to assets@redwood.com and attach it to the expense.
Rafael G.: any cap on amounts reimbursed for baggage or shipping?
Maya (People Ops): no hard cap for legitimate business equipment transport, but reviewers will check reasonableness. if the charge looks extreme we may ask for Travel Desk quotes or require corporate shipping. For bulky recurring shipments we may require centralized logistics.
Rafael G.: ok. receipts: what exactly should i upload to Expensify?
Maya (People Ops): upload the itemized baggage/shipping receipt, boarding pass (to show same trip), photos of the packed item (labelled), manager approval, and if applicable the courier's insurance/declared value docs. Add a short note: "Demo kit for customer X on [date]".
FinanceBot: finance adds: if carrier provided insurance or declared value fees, include the policy/invoice. If you paid in a foreign currency, include a card statement or conversion. If reimbursement goes to vendor >$600/year, additional vendor paperwork may be required.
Rafael G.: i paid $240 on my card. jordan approved. sending the email now. thanks all :thumbsup:
